activity_rule: Existing frozen thresholds; any SNR dispatch uses the estimated noise variance. No test-label calibration.

sources.somp: Tropp-Gilbert-Strauss Algorithm 3.1: stopping criterion is an input; external noise estimation is a project adaptation.
sources.gamp: Zhang 2023 Eqs. (17)-(19): complex MMV Gamma-MAP adaptation. Preserve the existing project prior strength c=1+LM and use d=LM*spatial_noise_estimate. The data-dependent prior scale is a project adaptation, not an independent extra observation or a paper-specified hyperparameter value.
sources.gnn: Ding 2026 Eqs. (12)-(13), (19), (26): supplied sigma squared; external noise estimation is a project adaptation.
sources.offgrid_sbl: Wei 2022 Eqs. (45)-(46), with shared MMV posterior uncertainty and Algorithm 1 noise initialization. The observation-estimated Gamma scale c=1+LM, d=LM*spatial_noise_estimate is a project adaptation; Sec. VI-A instead uses c=d=1e-4. The same observation sets the prior scale and enters the likelihood, so it is not independent extra data.
sources.spatial_estimator: Wax-Kailath MDL as restated by Nadakuditi-Edelman TSP 2008 Sec. I-B Eqs. (5)-(7); trailing-eigenvalue mean is the fitted white-noise variance.
